note: These executable-contract inputs remain frozen while synthetic-only Stage 2/3 engineering proceeds. AC-10 now has an immutable event/replay implementation. Stage 0 and the real-corpus higher stages do not claim to pass.

scenarios.title: Distinct-family parity evidence stays local
scenarios.given: Three correct, unassisted parity items from distinct families
scenarios.then: Parity competence rises and uncertainty narrows without materially raising unrelated geometry skills

scenarios.title: Confounded error causes modest distributed evidence
scenarios.then: The update is modest and controlled contrast probes precede any causal label

scenarios.title: Hinted retry is not independent mastery
scenarios.given: A correct answer after a hint and retry
scenarios.then: Learning activity is recorded but independent mastery evidence is discounted

scenarios.title: Competence and fluency remain separate
scenarios.given: A slow, unassisted correct answer with valid timing
scenarios.then: Competence rises while fluency receives a separate confirmation signal

scenarios.title: Missing prerequisite selects the frontier
scenarios.given: A repeatedly weak target with an unresolved prerequisite
scenarios.then: The planner selects the prerequisite frontier rather than another target-level item

scenarios.title: Review urgency is not competence collapse
scenarios.given: Time passes after a skill met its mastery evidence gate
scenarios.then: Review urgency increases without arbitrarily erasing the competence posterior

scenarios.title: Repeats do not masquerade as transfer
scenarios.given: An exact repeat and an immediate same-family variant
scenarios.then: Both are excluded from independent transfer evidence

scenarios.title: Diagnostic and practice policies have different purposes
scenarios.given: The same eligible corpus and learner posterior
scenarios.then: Diagnostic selection favors blueprint-constrained information while practice composes productive difficulty, review, and transfer

scenarios.title: Unproductive attempts change remediation type
scenarios.given: Two unproductive attempts and no suitable easier instructional item
scenarios.then: The engine selects a worked or faded example, or returns CONTENT_GAP

scenarios.title: Replay is exact
scenarios.given: The same immutable events, versions, configuration, and seed
scenarios.then: Event replay reconstructs exactly the same learner state and policy decisions
